claim_legs.durability: Prospective source pins, exact predecessor inputs and complete first-run copies are tracked. Saved-only audit/recovery/preflight pass without original raw logs or fixture replay. Native trace adaptation authenticates mechanically; book, Knowledge Map, task evidence and exact acceptance history preserve the resume frontier.
claim_legs.falsify: Recursive source-scope predictions agree with committed interval selection and independent original-scope or prefix reconstruction across pure variants and actual cases. Altered row/domain/header, recipe, prediction, recovery and book controls reject lost or changed ownership, primaries, declaration order, errors, reads, closes and effects.
claim_legs.rederive: Prospective current-flow recipes and immutable ordinary observations separately record actual reads, actual closes, reported errors, primary exceptions, public attempts and file effects. The book watcher recounts categories and original TAP independently.

commit_gate: Required staged doctrine and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Equal-reference, active-runtime and last-observation file-fixture compositions, full close-report join, genuine omissions, final release, native/lifetime and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain open.
scope: Only the ordinary actual composition matrix executes; other profiles receive pure binding/oracle checks only.
